name: PRO-LAD
toxicities: FreeODwiki says pharmacology, metabolism and toxicity data for PRO-LAD are very limited and human-use history short; exact toxic dose is unknown.
effectsSummary: FreeODwiki describes PRO-LAD as an LSD-like psychedelic, with reported potency comparable to LSD and effects reported around 100-200 µg. Human pharmacology, metabolism and toxicity data are very limited; the effects section is marked as a stub.
dosageRemark: Archived oral table: threshold 20 µg, light 50-100 µg, moderate 100-200 µg, strong 200-350 µg, heavy 350 µg+; total 6-8 h, onset 30-45 min. User/resource educational information, not a recommendation. Human data are sparse and the subjective-effects section is a stub; lightMin corrected from threshold to source light lower bound.
generalRisks: The source says PRO-LAD has sparse human data and recommends harm reduction. Subjective effects may be incomplete because that section is marked as a stub.
longtermRisks: FreeODwiki provides very limited pharmacology, metabolism and toxicity information and no established long-term human findings.
saferUse: FreeODwiki strongly recommends harm reduction because human evidence is limited.
